q: Chemistry plays an essential role to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development ____.
e: Chemistry plays an essential role to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Goals is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The agricultural sustainability is the area that requires green chemistry strategies in the manufacturing of ____.
e: The agricultural sustainability is the area that requires green chemistry strategies in the manufacturing of agrochemicals. Green chemistry designs products and processes so they make less hazardous waste.

q: Organic farming uses fertilisers of organic origin such as compost manure, green manure, and bone meal instead of chemical ____.
e: Organic farming uses fertilisers of organic origin such as compost manure, green manure, and bone meal instead of chemical fertilisers. Fertilisers is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Instead of using chemical-based pesticides, plant-based pesticides that have minimum risks including essential oils and insecticidal soaps can be ____.
e: Instead of using chemical-based pesticides, plant-based pesticides that have minimum risks including essential oils and insecticidal soaps can be used. Used is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The neem leaves consist of insecticidal ingredients and they can be used as an ____.
e: The neem leaves consist of insecticidal ingredients and they can be used as an insecticide. Insecticide is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Agrochemists have developed formulation technology to produce plant-based ____.
e: Agrochemists have developed formulation technology to produce plant-based pesticides. Pesticides is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Generally, a plant-based pesticide forms a stable water soluble complex with nutrient molecules to prevent mineralisation in the soil and facilitate foliar application directly to the ____.
e: Generally, a plant-based pesticide forms a stable water soluble complex with nutrient molecules to prevent mineralisation in the soil and facilitate foliar application directly to the leaves. Leaves is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Plant-based insecticidal soaps can be used either on indoor plants or on outdoor plants, including vegetables to eliminate small soft-bodied ____.
e: Plant-based insecticidal soaps can be used either on indoor plants or on outdoor plants, including vegetables to eliminate small soft-bodied insects. Insects is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Insecticidal soaps leave no nasty residue, are non-toxic to animals and birds, and do not harm beneficial ____.
e: Insecticidal soaps leave no nasty residue, are non-toxic to animals and birds, and do not harm beneficial insects. Insects is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The municipal and non-hazardous industrial wastes have been converted to energy by direct ____.
e: The municipal and non-hazardous industrial wastes have been converted to energy by direct burning. Burning is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: In waste gasification, much of the organic content wastes in the reactor produce a mixture of hydrogen and carbon ____.
e: In waste gasification, much of the organic content wastes in the reactor produce a mixture of hydrogen and carbon monoxide. Monoxide is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The gas mixture is sent to a catalytic system that converts it to ethanol and methanol or other liquid fuels or ____.
e: The gas mixture is sent to a catalytic system that converts it to ethanol and methanol or other liquid fuels or chemicals. Chemicals is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, biorefineries, geothermal, and tidal energy are important resources for future sustainable ____.
e: Solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, biorefineries, geothermal, and tidal energy are important resources for future sustainable development. Development is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Ethanol is the most important alcohol which can be produced by converting the sugar content of any starchy material into alcohol with the evolution of carbon ____.
e: Ethanol is the most important alcohol which can be produced by converting the sugar content of any starchy material into alcohol with the evolution of carbon dioxide. Dioxide is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Productions of ethanol are from lignocellulosic materials such as corncob, cornstalk, cornhusk, sugarcane bagasse and sugarcane ____.
e: Productions of ethanol are from lignocellulosic materials such as corncob, cornstalk, cornhusk, sugarcane bagasse and sugarcane bark. Bark is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Biodiesel oil is produced from cultivated plant ____.
e: Biodiesel oil is produced from cultivated plant oil. Biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: Biodiesel oil is synthesised from plant oils by removing the by-product glycerine molecule, valuable raw material for soap ____.
e: Biodiesel oil is synthesised from plant oils by removing the by-product glycerine molecule, valuable raw material for soap production. Biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: Biodiesel oil also can be obtained from waste plant oils, e.g., oils used in ____.
e: Biodiesel oil also can be obtained from waste plant oils,, oils used in restaurants. Biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: The combustion of fossil fuel generates sulphur compounds whereas biodiesel does ____.
e: The combustion of fossil fuel generates sulphur compounds whereas biodiesel does not. Not: biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: Many clean water resources are becoming increasingly scarce and many of them are polluted by anthropogenic sources such as industrial purposes, agricultural waste and ____.
e: Many clean water resources are becoming increasingly scarce and many of them are polluted by anthropogenic sources such as industrial purposes, agricultural waste and household. Household is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The main purpose of wastewater treatment is to remove the various contaminants that are present in the ____.
e: The main purpose of wastewater treatment is to remove the various contaminants that are present in the wastewater. Wastewater is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The green materials such as agricultural waste adsorbent, activated carbon, and rice husk-derived ceramic materials are usually applied in the wastewater treatment ____.
e: The green materials such as agricultural waste adsorbent, activated carbon, and rice husk-derived ceramic materials are usually applied in the wastewater treatment system. System is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: The photocatalysts binary metal oxides nanomaterials are also used to mineralise, decompose, and oxidise the pollutants from ____.
e: The photocatalysts binary metal oxides nanomaterials are also used to mineralise, decompose, and oxidise the pollutants from wastewater. Wastewater is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Previously, tetraethyllead (TEL) was used as an anti-knocking ____.
e: Previously, tetraethyllead (TEL) was used as an anti-knocking agent. Agent is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Nowadays, tetraethyllead is replaced by using methyl tert-butyl ether (____).
e: Nowadays, tetraethyllead is replaced by using methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE). Ethers have an oxygen bridged between two carbon groups and are often used as solvents.

q: Methyl tert-butyl ether is a flammable liquid that has been used as an additive for unleaded ____.
e: Methyl tert-butyl ether is a flammable liquid that has been used as an additive for unleaded petrol. Ethers have an oxygen bridged between two carbon groups and are often used as solvents.

q: Bioplastics are derived from renewable biomass sources such as corn starch, vegetable oils and ____.
e: Bioplastics are derived from renewable biomass sources such as corn starch, vegetable oils and fats. Fats is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Solvents like tetrachloroethene used in dry cleaning of clothes, pollute the groundwater and are ____.
e: Solvents like tetrachloroethene used in dry cleaning of clothes, pollute the groundwater and are carcinogenic. Carcinogenic is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: In the liquid $CO_2$ cleaning process, liquid carbon dioxide and other non-toxic cleaning materials replace ____.
e: In the liquid CO2 cleaning process, liquid carbon dioxide and other non-toxic cleaning materials replace tetrachloroethene. Tetrachloroethene is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Dry cleaners pressurise and then liquefy $CO_2$ gas to make it a powerful solvent for cleaning clothing ____.
e: Dry cleaners pressurise and then liquefy CO2 gas to make it a powerful solvent for cleaning clothing items. Items is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Green chemistry can design chemical products and processes that reduce or eliminate the use or generation of hazardous ____.
e: Green chemistry can design chemical products and processes that reduce or eliminate the use or generation of hazardous substances. Green chemistry designs products and processes so they make less hazardous waste.

q: Large amounts of adipic acid are used each year for the production of nylon, polyurethanes, lubricants and ____.
e: Large amounts of adipic acid are used each year for the production of nylon, polyurethanes, lubricants and plasticisers. Plasticisers is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Benzene, a compound with convinced carcinogenic properties, is a standard substrate for the production of adipic ____.
e: Benzene, a compound with convinced carcinogenic properties, is a standard substrate for the production of adipic acid. Acid is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Glucose can be converted into adipic acid by an enzyme discovered in genetically modified ____.
e: Glucose can be converted into adipic acid by an enzyme discovered in genetically modified bacteria. Enzymes are protein catalysts that speed specific biochemical reactions.

q: Hexavalent chromium plating produces several by-products which are considered as hazardous waste, including lead chromates and barium ____.
e: Hexavalent chromium plating produces several by-products which are considered as hazardous waste, including lead chromates and barium sulphate. Sulphate is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Hexavalent chromium itself is a hazardous substance and ____.
e: Hexavalent chromium itself is a hazardous substance and carcinogen. Carcinogen is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Trivalent chromium is another method of decorative chrome plating, and is considered as an environmentally friendly alternative to hexavalent ____.
e: Trivalent chromium is another method of decorative chrome plating, and is considered as an environmentally friendly alternative to hexavalent chromium. Chromium is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Trivalent chromium plating uses chromium sulphate or chromium chloride as its main ingredient, instead of chromium(VI) ____.
e: Trivalent chromium plating uses chromium sulphate or chromium chloride as its main ingredient, instead of chromium(VI) oxide. Oxide is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Vermilion is a dense, opaque pigment with a clear, brilliant hue originally made by grinding a powder of cinnabar (mercury(II) sulphide, ____).
e: Vermilion is a dense, opaque pigment with a clear, brilliant hue originally made by grinding a powder of cinnabar (mercury(II) sulphide, HgS). HgS is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Arsenic trisulphide ($As_2S_3$) is used as orpiment in works of art and is highly desirable as a pigment mostly in ____.
e: Arsenic trisulphide (As2S3) is used as orpiment in works of art and is highly desirable as a pigment mostly in lacquerware. Lacquerware is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Bananas are naturally high in potassium, which is a mix of isotopes, including the slightly radioactive isotope potassium-____.
e: Bananas are naturally high in potassium, which is a mix of isotopes, including the slightly radioactive isotope potassium-40. 40 is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.

q: Clove oil, mint oil, lemongrass oil, cinnamon oil, rosemary oil and oil of oregano are the best-known essential oils containing organic compounds with bioactivity against insects and other ____.
e: Clove oil, mint oil, lemongrass oil, cinnamon oil, rosemary oil and oil of oregano are the best-known essential oils containing organic compounds with bioactivity against insects and other pests. Pests is the chemical word that makes this relationship true.
